images.headline: Start Monday with a fresh look
images.support: Try the booking process as a first visitor.
images.composition: horizontal silver carabiner cropped extreme lower right below upper left offwhite type on cobalt
images.alt_text: An unmarked silver carabiner rests beneath a reminder to try the booking process as a first visitor.
images.suggested_caption:
Start the week by trying the booking process from a customer's point of view.

Follow the steps from the first page to the confirmation. Notice anything that makes you stop, guess, or search for the next action.

images.headline: Your service area should be easy to find
images.support: Say where you work before customers send a request.
images.composition: thin offwhite plaster terrain along bottom beneath high centered navy service area message on sage
images.alt_text: A small sculpted landscape sits beneath a message about making the business service area clear.
images.suggested_caption:
A visitor should be able to tell whether you serve their location.

State the towns, neighborhoods, or distance you cover near the request form. Explain how someone can check a location that falls outside the listed area.

images.headline: Detailers, explain vehicle dropoff before arrival
images.support: Confirm the location, arrival window, and key handover.
images.composition: single plain navy headed vehicle key lying diagonally lower left beside upper right navy type on offwhite
images.alt_text: A plain vehicle key accompanies a reminder for detailers to explain the dropoff location, timing, and key handover.
images.suggested_caption:
A vehicle dropoff should come with clear instructions.

For shop appointments, confirm the location, arrival window, and how keys will be handed over. Explain how the customer will hear when the vehicle is ready.

images.headline: Illustrative: 80 − 25 = 55 minutes
images.support: Example time remaining in a planned work block.
images.composition: amber river stone cropped upper left above lower right offwhite subtraction equation on navy
images.alt_text: An explicitly illustrative equation shows that 80 minutes less 25 minutes leaves 55 minutes beside a smooth stone.
images.suggested_caption:
Illustrative planning example: an 80 minute work block with 25 minutes used leaves 55 minutes.

Those figures are assumptions for the calculation. Replace them with your own planned time and time already used.

images.headline: What should happen when the job is finished?
images.support: Name the detail that makes the handoff easier.
images.composition: sealed plain kraft parcel at upper right above low centered navy question on muted blue
images.alt_text: A plain sealed parcel sits above a question about which details make a completed job easier to hand over.
images.suggested_caption:
When a job is complete, the last message still matters.

Would you want a summary, a collection time, care instructions, or a clear receipt? Share the detail that helps you know what to do next.
